store.template: Someone tapped your screen {count} times.

must: NOOBIA P1 touch tap count=3 dur_ms=90 | taps on the panel
must_not: NOOBIA P1 touch hold count=1 dur_ms=2000 | a hold

store.template: Someone pressed and held your screen for {dur_ms} ms.
store.message: Someone pressed and held your screen.

must: NOOBIA P1 touch hold dur_ms=2100 | a hold on the panel
must_not: NOOBIA P1 touch tap dur_ms=90 | a tap

store.template: With your {cam} camera you see {label*}.

must: NOOBIA P1 camera objects.seen cam=back n=3 | laptop(0.7534)/person(0.873)/cat(0.452)
NOOBIA P1 camera objects.seen cam=front n=1 | cup(0.61)
must_not: NOOBIA P0 camera frame.analyzed objects=0 | nothing

store.template: With your {cam} camera you see {label*}. It looks like this: {caption}

must: NOOBIA P1 camera objects.seen cam=wide n=2 | mouse(0.85)/laptop(0.72) ~ A desk with a laptop and a monitor.
must_not: NOOBIA P1 camera objects.seen cam=wide n=2 | mouse(0.85)/laptop(0.72)

store.template: With your {cam} camera you see this: {caption}

must: NOOBIA P1 camera scene.seen cam=wide | A person sitting at a computer in a dark room.
must_not: NOOBIA P1 camera objects.seen cam=wide n=1 | cup(0.8)

store.template: You see a {label}.

must: NOOBIA P1 camera object.seen label=cat conf=0.91 | a cat
must_not: NOOBIA P1 camera objects.seen cam=back n=1 | cat(0.9)

store.template: You are now {to}, tilted {tilt} degrees from flat.

must: NOOBIA P1 motion position.change to=horizontal from=vertical tilt=8 | placed flat
must_not: NOOBIA P0 motion status.sample orientation=flat_up | sample

store.template: Someone picked you up; you are now {to}.

must: NOOBIA P1 motion pickup to=portrait from=flat_up | picked up
must_not: NOOBIA P1 motion placed to=flat_up from=portrait | placed

store.template: You were put down; you are now {to}.

must: NOOBIA P1 motion placed to=flat_up from=portrait | placed
must_not: NOOBIA P1 motion pickup to=portrait from=flat_up | picked up

store.template: Your temperature {dir} to {c} C, {delta} degrees since the last check.

must: NOOBIA P1 power temp.change dir=rose c=41 delta=6 prev=35 | warmer
must_not: NOOBIA P1 power thermal.hot soc_mc=45000 state=charging | warm

store.template: You are getting warm: {soc_mc} millidegrees, {state}.

must: NOOBIA P1 power thermal.hot soc_mc=45000 state=charging | warm
must_not: NOOBIA P1 power temp.change dir=rose c=41 delta=6 | warmer

store.template: Your power changed from {from} to {to}.

must: NOOBIA P1 power charging.change from=discharging to=charging | Lynx is now charging
must_not: NOOBIA P1 power battery.low cap=15 state=discharging | low

store.template: Your battery is getting low: {cap} percent.

must: NOOBIA P1 power battery.low cap=15 state=discharging | low
must_not: NOOBIA P1 power battery.critical cap=4 state=discharging | critical

store.template: Your battery is critically low: {cap} percent.

must: NOOBIA P1 power battery.critical cap=4 state=discharging | critical
must_not: NOOBIA P1 power battery.low cap=15 state=discharging | low

store.template: You heard a sound, loudness {peak}.

must: NOOBIA P1 hearing sound.heard peak=279 rms=12.1 | Lynx heard sound
must_not: NOOBIA P0 hearing status.sample peak=10 rms=3.2 | sample

store.template: The light around you became bright.
store.message: The light around you became bright.

must: NOOBIA P1 light bright raw=900 | bright
must_not: NOOBIA P1 light dark raw=2 | dark

store.template: It became dark around you.

must: NOOBIA P1 light dark raw=2 | dark
must_not: NOOBIA P1 light bright raw=900 | bright

store.template: Something came close to your face.
store.message: Something came close to your face.

must: NOOBIA P1 proximity near dist=0 | near
must_not: NOOBIA P1 proximity far dist=5 | far

store.template: The thing near your face moved away.
store.message: The thing near your face moved away.

must: NOOBIA P1 proximity far dist=5 | far
must_not: NOOBIA P1 proximity near dist=0 | near

store.template: A new device appeared on your network at {ip}.
store.message: A new device appeared on your network.

must: NOOBIA P1 network device.seen ip=192.168.100.50 mac=aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff | seen
must_not: NOOBIA P1 network device.lost ip=192.168.100.50 | lost

store.template: The device at {ip} left your network.

must: NOOBIA P1 network device.lost ip=192.168.100.50 | lost
must_not: NOOBIA P1 network device.seen ip=192.168.100.50 mac=aa:bb | seen

store.template: Your Wi-Fi went down.

must: NOOBIA P1 wifi link.down iface=wlan0 | Wi-Fi went down
must_not: NOOBIA P1 wifi link.up iface=wlan0 | Wi-Fi is back

store.template: Your Wi-Fi is back.

must: NOOBIA P1 wifi link.up iface=wlan0 | Wi-Fi is back
must_not: NOOBIA P1 wifi link.down iface=wlan0 | Wi-Fi went down

store.template: Your Wi-Fi signal is weak: {signal} dBm.

must: NOOBIA P1 wifi rssi.low signal=-82 iface=wlan0 | weak
must_not: NOOBIA P1 wifi link.up iface=wlan0 | back

store.template: Nexus, your home, is reachable again.

must: NOOBIA P1 nexus reachable host=192.168.100.106 port=112 | back
must_not: NOOBIA P1 nexus unreachable host=192.168.100.106 port=112 errors=3 | gone

store.template: You cannot reach Nexus, your home.

must: NOOBIA P1 nexus unreachable host=192.168.100.106 port=112 errors=3 | gone
must_not: NOOBIA P1 nexus reachable host=192.168.100.106 port=112 | back
